title: The gate's 16 KiB inline-output bound is now declared twice and can drift
body: internal/reconcile and internal/gating each declare maxInlineOutput = 16 << 10 and their own bound() helper, and both are documented as 'the gate's own bound' — but nothing ties them together, so a change to one silently leaves the oracle's records at the old bound. Hosting the constant (and the bound) once — runstate is the natural home, beside InlineOutput.MaxBytes — would make the documented coupling real.
